about.title: Industry-focused legal information and professional support
about.paragraphOne: SIWA Legal Support helps industries understand common legal and regulatory issues, submit an initial assistance request and find an appropriate next step.
about.paragraphTwo: Where suitable, a request may be routed to a legal professional after an initial review, availability check and conflict check. Advice or representation begins only after the professional separately accepts the matter and confirms the terms of engagement.

whoWeAre.title: A responsible route to legal support
whoWeAre.paragraphOne: SIWA Legal Support helps industries understand common legal issues, submit an initial assistance request and, where appropriate, connect with a qualified legal professional.
whoWeAre.paragraphTwo: The platform provides general information and an initial point of contact. It does not itself guarantee legal advice, acceptance of a matter, representation or any particular result.
whoWeAre.imageAlt: Illustrative discussion between industry representatives and legal professionals

mission.title: Making legal support easier to approach
mission.text: To help industries understand legal risk, seek timely assistance and reach suitable legal professionals through a clear and responsible process.

vision.title: An accessible and professional legal-support system
vision.text: To build an informed industrial community that can identify legal concerns early, use reliable information and seek qualified advice when needed.

objectives.title: Focused on responsible legal support
objectives.description: The service combines accessible information, structured intake and professional safeguards.

items.represent: Provide a clear route for initial legal-assistance requests
items.cooperation: Connect suitable matters with legal professionals after verification and conflict checks
items.infrastructure: Support notice, reply and representation needs after engagement
items.awareness: Improve awareness of laws, compliance and government schemes
items.development: Help industries identify legal risk at an early stage
items.training: Organise legal-awareness sessions and compliance workshops
items.networking: Encourage responsible exchange within the legal-professionals network
items.responsibleGrowth: Protect privacy, minimise data and avoid outcome guarantees

membership.title: Initial Legal-Assistance Request
membership.subtitle: Tell us briefly about the legal issue affecting your enterprise
membership.description: Submitting this form is an initial request only. It does not create an advocate–client relationship, confirm acceptance of the matter or guarantee advice, representation or an outcome.
membership.formDescription: Complete the required fields with a brief factual summary. Do not upload or include confidential, privileged or highly sensitive material at this stage.
membership.consent: I agree that SIWA or a relevant legal professional may contact me about this request. I understand that submission does not itself establish an advocate–client relationship or representation.
membership.successMessage: Thank you. Your initial request has been received. Availability, conflict checks, acceptance and next steps will be confirmed separately.

membership.privacyNote: Information submitted here should be used only to review and respond to your assistance request, in accordance with the published privacy notice.
